top_signals.title: BitGo launches Link, connecting clients to Coinbase, Kraken, Crypto.com and more
top_signals.summary: BitGo Link provides a single interface for viewing and moving digital assets held both in BitGo custody and on centralized exchanges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
